metadata.description: Azure region for all dashboard resources.
Globally unique Function App name for the experimental Azure Functions dashboard profile.
Azure App Service plan name for the Function App.
Application Insights component name.
Globally unique storage account name for Azure Functions runtime state.
Globally unique Azure Container Registry name containing the Function App image.
Container repository containing the CAO Azure Functions runtime.
Immutable or reviewed tag of the CAO Azure Functions runtime image.
Key Vault name used for GitHub OAuth, session, PostgreSQL, and collection secrets.
TLS PostgreSQL URL shared by canonical dashboard storage and the isolated operational adapter.
Maximum bytes retained in the disposable operational cache.
Maximum size of one disposable operational cache value.
Maximum number of disposable operational cache entries.
Maximum bytes retained in protected operational records.
Maximum number of protected operational records.
Number of days of canonical run history retained in PostgreSQL. Keep this at least as large as the published dashboard snapshot window.
Public host names that Azure Front Door/App Service is allowed to forward to the Go dashboard handler.
GitHub organizations whose active members are authorized.
GitHub teams whose active members are authorized, expressed as org/team-slug.
GitHub user logins authorized directly, without organization membership lookup.
GitHub OAuth App client ID. Do not use a PAT; the server only supports the OAuth authorization-code flow.
GitHub OAuth App client secret. It is written only to Key Vault and consumed by the Function App through a Key Vault reference.
At least 32 characters of random session secret material used to encrypt server-side OAuth sessions.
Optional previous session secret retained during controlled key rotation until active sessions and pending revocations are drained.
Optional Log Analytics workspace resource ID for Application Insights. Leave empty to create classic component-only telemetry.
Optional container image running the collection role. Empty deploys no collection.
GitHub App identifier whose installations define ingestion scope. Required with collectorImage.
GitHub App private key in PEM form. Required with collectorImage.
Shared secret verifying GitHub webhook deliveries. Required with collectorImage.
GitHub logins permitted to run administrative operations.
Control repository used for logical source discovery, in OWNER/REPOSITORY form.
Fixed number of PostgreSQL-backed collection workers.
Evidence lake file share tier. Premium is provisioned SSD; Standard is IOPS-throttled by share size.
